newsitem.title: USA: CarrAmerica buys 8 properties for $124 mln.
newsitem.headline: CarrAmerica buys 8 properties for $124 mln.

text.p: CarrAmerica Realty Corp said Monday it purchased eight properties in California's Silicon Valley consisting of 21 suburban office buildings with a total of about one million square feet for $124 million.
The properties, referred to as the NELO/Orchard portfolio, were built between 1979 and 1985, the company said.
The properties are all located in the North First Street Corridor near the San Jose Airport and have excellent access from major highways. The portfolio is 100 percent leased.

"We believe the purchase of this portfolio provides CarrAmerica with extremely functional, flexible office properties exactly where the fastest growing Silicon Valley companies need them -- in the heart of the Golden Triangle with excellent access to major highways and the San Jose airport," the company said.
